GWIS.title: GWIS
GWIS.abstract: The Global Wildfire Information System (GWIS) supports the services in charge of the protection of forests against fires and provides the European Commission services and the European Parliament with updated and reliable information on wildland fires at the global level.

ecmwf.fwi.title: ecmwf.fwi
ecmwf.fwi.abstract: Fire Weather Index (FWI) from ECMWF reanalysis data. The FWI is a numerical rating of fire intensity and potential fire behavior, based on weather conditions such as temperature, humidity, wind speed, and precipitation. It is commonly used in wildfire management and forecasting to assess fire risk and guide firefighting efforts.

ecmwf.ffmc.title: ecmwf.ffmc
ecmwf.ffmc.abstract: Fine Fuel Moisture Code (FFMC) from ECMWF reanalysis data. The FFMC is a numerical rating of the moisture content of fine fuels, such as grass and leaves, which can influence the ignition and spread of wildfires. It is commonly used in wildfire management and forecasting to assess fire risk and guide firefighting efforts.

ecmwf.dmc.title: ecmwf.dmc
ecmwf.dmc.abstract: Duff Moisture Code (DMC) from ECMWF reanalysis data. The DMC is a numerical rating of the moisture content of medium-sized fuels, such as shrubs and small branches, which can influence the ignition and spread of wildfires. It is commonly used in wildfire management and forecasting to assess fire risk and guide firefighting efforts.

ecmwf.dc.title: ecmwf.dc
ecmwf.dc.abstract: Drought Code (DC) from ECMWF reanalysis data. The DC is a numerical rating of the moisture content of deep, compacted organic layers, which can influence the ignition and spread of wildfires. It is commonly used in wildfire management and forecasting to assess fire risk and guide firefighting efforts.

ecmwf.isi.title: ecmwf.isi
ecmwf.isi.abstract: Initial Spread Index (ISI) from ECMWF reanalysis data. The ISI is a numerical rating of the expected rate of fire spread immediately after ignition, based on weather conditions such as wind speed and fine fuel moisture content. It is commonly used in wildfire management and forecasting to assess fire risk and guide firefighting efforts.

ecmwf.bui.title: ecmwf.bui
ecmwf.bui.abstract: Buildup Index (BUI) from ECMWF reanalysis data. The BUI is a numerical rating of the total amount of fuel available for combustion, based on weather conditions such as precipitation and temperature. It is commonly used in wildfire management and forecasting to assess fire risk and guide firefighting efforts.

ecmwf.extra.wind.uv.abstract: The GWIS ECMWF 10m Wind Vector layer provides a near-real-time forecast of 10-meter wind speed and direction derived from U and V components of the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF) Integrated Forecast System.

EFFIS.title: EFFIS
EFFIS.abstract: The European Forest Fire Information System (EFFIS) supports the services in charge of the protection of forests against fires in the EU countries and provides the European Commission services and the European Parliament with updated and reliable information on wildland fires in Europe.
